fields.FIR_Description: During the afternoon of 2025-07-07, around 14:20, Rs. 32,000 was debited from the account of the complainant through UPI after a collect request from an unknown UPI ID was approved, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-07-14. Contact details given by the complainant, Malathi Kumari, include the number 9000000092. Transaction details refer to the receiving account SYN-ACC-100025. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. A person named Kishore Babu, associated with the number 9000000076, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The complainant mentioned social media screenshots and digital documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Fraudulent QR code allegedly shared under the pretext of a refund.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, suspect, apartment complex, screenshot, afternoon, receiving account, digital document
